elements.label: Field description hover cards (Delivery status, Impact/Effort, Importance) flash in and out
elements.text: The status of delivery tickets from Jira Software (epics, issues) that are linked to the idea. For more details open each idea and the "Deliver" section

elements.label: Delivery status toggle: cursor and 'Add to view' tooltip leave
Delivery status row hover highlight clears

pattern.description: The cursor slides down the Fields panel; each field row it passes pops a short-lived description hover card to its left, which disappears as the cursor moves on and leaves the panel at rest.
pattern.why_premium: Incidental, not designed: the hover cards flash for a frame or two each and read as noise. A premium rebuild would hold one card long enough to read or drop them entirely.

build_hint.gsap: If recreated: gsap.to(cursor, {y: '+=70', duration: 0.3, ease: 'power1.inOut'}); per hovered row, a timeline of gsap.fromTo(card, {autoAlpha: 0, x: 8}, {autoAlpha: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.out'}) followed by autoAlpha 0 on leave; row background highlight toggled with a 0.1s fade.
build_hint.remotion: Cursor y = interpolate(frame, [0, 9], [y0, y1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}); hovered row index from cursor y; card opacity = interpolate(frame - enterFrame, [0, 3], [0, 1]) and back to 0 on exit; highlight via a conditional background colour.

notes: Hover cards are transient and absent from the end frame; b01 is the union box that covers the area where they appeared to the left of the panel. Cursor is not clearly visible at the end frame. Not a meaningful designed motion; mostly incidental screen-recording hover noise.
